Our self-administered NAD+ injections rapidly boost NAD+ levels, revitalizing trillions of cells throughout your body to support energy, resilience, and overall vitality.

Ingredients: NAD+ (1000 mg per vial = up to 20 doses)

  • Same-day prescription approval
  • No insurance required
  • Compounded by a US-licensed pharmacy
  • Lab tested for quality and safety
  • Expedited (two-day) shipping
  • Delivered directly to your home
  • In stock, ready to ship

Key Benefits:

  • Replenish NAD+: Your body requires a steady supply of NAD+. With NAD+ injections, you can effortlessly and continuously sustain healthy NAD+ levels.
  • Enhance Cellular Energy: NAD+ plays a vital role in mitochondrial function, helping to fuel ATP energy production and promote true vitality at the cellular level.
  • Boost Cognitive Function : NAD+ supports your brain’s energy pathways, helping to boost mental clarity, focus, and cognitive function as you age.
  • Optimize Aging: NAD+ addresses all 12 hallmarks of aging, promoting DNA repair and activating sirtuins—critical factors in maintaining youthful vitality and supporting healthy aging.

What Is NAD+?

NAD+ (Nicotinamide Adenine Dinucleotide) is a coenzyme found in every cell of your body that naturally declines with age. NAD+ injections provide a direct, bioavailable form of this essential coenzyme, supporting your body’s natural ability to heal, repair, and thrive.

How it Works:

  1. Brief Questionnaire - Complete an online health history form in just five minutes.
  2. Doctor Approval - A licensed medical professional will evaluate your intake form.
  3. Expedited Shipping - If approved, your prescription will be prepared and shipped from an FDA-regulated 503a pharmacy in the US.
  4. Continuous Support - Enjoy 24/7 access to our dedicated care team via HIPAA-compliant messaging or telephone.

Why Choose ProHealth NAD+ Injections?

  • Our NAD+ Injections are made to the highest standards of quality and purity, using premium ingredients and state-of-the-art manufacturing processes to ensure potency, safety, and effectiveness in every dose.
  • Each product is dispensed through U.S.-licensed pharmacies specializing in compounding and undergoes rigorous third-party testing in FDA- and DEA-registered laboratories to ensure uncompromising quality.

What is included?

Each NAD+ Injection kit includes a one- to three-month supply of NAD+, a sterile injection kit and alcohol swabs for convenience and safety.

How much NAD+ is in each injection?

Our NAD+ formulation contains 100mg/mL . A 10mL vial includes a total of 1000mg NAD+, and a 30mL vial includes 3,000mg NAD+ total. A single 0.1mL injection contains 10mg NAD+, a 0.25ml injection contains 25mg NAD+, and a 0.5ml injection contains 50mg NAD+.

How do I administer the injection?

Withdraw the prescribed amount using the insulin needle and syringe provided. Make the injection subcutaneously.

What part of my body should I place the injection?

Ideally, the injection is administered into a fatty layer of skin, such as the abdomen (at least 2 inches from the belly button), the flank/lumbar region, the front or outer thigh, and the outer back of the upper arm (with assistance).

Key Points to Remember:

  • Rotate injection sites with each dose and avoid areas with scar tissue, moles, or bruises. Do not inject through clothing.
  • Ensure the liquid in the syringe is clear and colorless. Discard it if cloudy or discolored.
  • Use a new needle for each injection.
  • Never share syringes, as this can spread infections.
  • Follow the specific instructions provided and consult your doctor or healthcare professional if you have questions about the technique. Detailed instructions are also included with your medication.

How often should I get NAD+ injections?

It depends on your health goals, but many people start with weekly injections and adjust as needed. Consult a healthcare provider to determine the optimal schedule for your specific health goals. Suggested Use:

  • For Longevity & Anti-Aging Support: One injection every 7-14 days, depending on your personal goals.
  • For Cognitive & Physical Performance: May be used more frequently under the guidance of a healthcare provider.

Always consult with a healthcare professional before starting any new regimen.

Are there any side effects?

NAD+ injections can have mild side effects, some of the most common include:

  • Pain or redness at the injection site
  • Nausea
  • Headache
  • Temporary fatigue
  • Gastrointestinal symptoms such as diarrhea or stomach upset

It is important to note that these side effects are usually mild and transient. Contact your healthcare provider if side effects persist or worsen.

Important safety information:

  • Consult a healthcare professional: Before beginning any new supplement, including NAD+, it is important to consult a healthcare professional to determine if it is appropriate for your individual needs and health conditions.
  • Potential side effects: NAD+ injections are generally well-tolerated. However, some may experience mild discomfort at the injection site or a temporary feeling of warmth. Other side effects may include nausea, headache, fatigue, or stomach discomfort. If you experience any severe or persistent side effects, discontinue use and consult your healthcare provider.
  • Drug interactions: NAD+ supplements may interact with certain medications, such as blood thinners, blood pressure medications, or chemotherapy drugs. Consult your healthcare professional to discuss potential interactions before starting NAD+ supplementation.
  • Allergies and sensitivities: If you have any known allergies or sensitivities to ingredients found in NAD+ supplements, avoid using the product or consult your healthcare provider for guidance.
  • Dosage and administration: Follow the recommended dosage and administration guidelines provided by your healthcare professional. Taking more than the recommended dose can increase the risk of side effects and may not provide additional benefits.
  • Pregnancy and breastfeeding: The safety of NAD+ supplementation during pregnancy and breastfeeding has not been well-studied. If you are pregnant or nursing, consult your healthcare provider before using NAD+ supplements.
  • Pre-existing health conditions: Individuals with certain pre-existing health conditions, such as kidney or liver disease, should consult their healthcare provider before starting NAD+ supplementation to ensure it is safe and appropriate for them.
  • Note: The above statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.
